```{python}
#| label: annotate

from sparknlp.base import DocumentAssembler, Pipeline
from sparknlp.annotator import (
    SentenceDetector,
    Tokenizer,
    Normalizer,
    PerceptronModel,
    LemmatizerModel
)

if do_annotation:
    document = (
        DocumentAssembler()
        .setInputCol("paragraph")
        .setOutputCol("document")
    )

    sentence_detector = (
        SentenceDetector()
        .setInputCols(["document"])
        .setOutputCol("sentences")
    )

    tokenizer = (
        Tokenizer()
        .setInputCols(["sentences"])
        .setOutputCol("tokens")
    )

    normalizer = (
        Normalizer()
        .setInputCols(["tokens"])
        .setOutputCol("normalized")
        .setLowercase(True)
    )

    pipeline = Pipeline(
        stages=[
            document,
            sentence_detector,
            tokenizer,
            normalizer
        ]
    )

    result = pipeline.fit(books).transform(books)
    result.write.parquet(str(annotation_cache))
else:
    result = spark.read.parquet(str(annotation_cache))

result.persist()
```
